verdict.rationale: Secureframe supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and other frameworks. Its frameworks page says each framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, with automated testing that collects evidence from integrated tools. That implies a shared control and evidence layer, but no evidence says work done for one framework carries over to another, or that the overlap is shown. Missing for 10: explicit cross-framework control and evidence reuse, automatic credit toward ISO 27001/HIPAA from SOC 2 work, an overlap/crosswalk view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
